steps.label: score-fixture
steps.sql: CREATE TABLE ScoreDocs (Id INT64 NOT NULL, Body STRING(MAX), BodyTokens TOKENLIST AS (TOKENIZE_FULLTEXT(Body)) HIDDEN) PRIMARY KEY(Id)

steps.label: score-search-index
steps.sql: CREATE SEARCH INDEX ScoreIndex ON ScoreDocs(BodyTokens)

steps.label: score-insert
statements: INSERT INTO ScoreDocs(Id,Body) VALUES (1,'cat cat dog'),(2,'cat dog'),(3,'dog')

steps.label: score-unpinned
steps.sql: SELECT Id, SCORE(BodyTokens,'cat') AS default_score, SCORE(BodyTokens,'cat', options => JSON '{"version": 1}') AS version1_score, SCORE(BodyTokens,'cat', options => JSON '{"version": 2}') AS version2_score FROM ScoreDocs ORDER BY Id

steps.label: bucket-fixture

steps.label: bucket-index-hour

steps.label: bucket-index-none
